summary: Prewarm tombstone leak leaves deprecated model variant serving after canary rewind
description: Issue summary: After a canary rollback (revert to previous model variant) during a scheduled migration, some tenant traffic continued to be routed to a deprecated variant that should have been tombstoned. Impact: NimbusAI observed mismatched responses (tokenization and hallucination deltas) in ~4% of requests for a subset of long-running sessions over a 35-minute window. The problem appears correlated with prewarm leader handoff and tombstone propagation delays across the edge-proxy fleet. Environment: Dedicated pool backing NimbusAI (prod:us-east-1), orchestrator version v2.14.3, prewarm-service v1.9. Steps to reproduce below. Observed vs Expected: Observed: traffic persisted to deprecated variant after orchestrator initiated a canary rewind and tombstone marker was written. Expected: tombstone should prevent any new session affinity or routing to the deprecated variant; existing sessions should be gracefully drained and then evicted.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Configure a weighted canary that promotes redwood/gpt-neox-2.7b-quant-v2 to 20% and run prewarm across dedicated pool.
2) After 10 minutes, trigger a manual canary rollback to the previous variant redwood/gpt-neox-2.7b-legacy via console (canary rewind + tombstone write).
3) Observe edge-proxy routing table and session affinity logs for tenant NimbusAI (tenant id masked).
4) Send long-chained requests (avg token length 600) with the same session token and record model id in responses over the next 1 hour.
Expected: No new requests should be routed to deprecated variant after tombstone is committed; any in-flight connections should be drained within configured grace period (120s).

investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 09:30 UTC — Triage by Support (Evelyn): Customer reported quality delta and attached request IDs showing model id mismatch. Initial suspicion: tombstone propagation lag.
2026-03-10 10:05 UTC — Eng (Diego): Pulled orchestrator audit logs; tombstone write confirmed at 2026-03-10T09:24:11Z and returned success synchronously to control plane.
2026-03-10 10:20 UTC — SRE (Priya Rao): Observed that prewarm leader handoff created a transient leader pointer update that delayed edge-proxy tombstone application by ~30-90s on ~12/150 edge shards.
2026-03-10 10:45 UTC — Eng: Found race between tombstone async fanout and kvcache merge-lock during shard reindex; shards with active merges ignored tombstone messages until merge completed.

2026-03-11 08:12 UTC — Postmortem hypothesis: tombstone markers were enqueued for async delivery; however, when an edge shard was mid-merge, tombstone application was deferred but session-affinity logic still allowed matching on stale routing metadata.

resolution_notes: Mitigation applied: temporarily prioritized tombstone fanout for affected tenant and added control-plane bypass to force tombstone apply on shards with active merges. Customer telemetry confirms dramatic reduction in mismatch. Permanent fix: engineering RFC accepted; change will add a tombstone-safe apply path and synchronous tombstone ACK for priority tenants. Patch targeted for v2.14.4 (ETA 2026-03-18).
